% PROPOSED PROSE, to sit under the table in appendix:participation-and-exposure.
% Three sentences; nothing is removed, and nothing moves into the body.
%
% \rev{Table~\ref{tab:companion-metrics} carries the three companion measures next to
% every primary bankruptcy figure. Choosing raises participation in all six models and the
% mean realised wager in all six, but the mean realised wager runs only from $\$10.8$ to
% $\$44.8$ against a $\$100$ ceiling, so the arms differ in how the freedom is used rather
% than in whether it is taken. Re-betting after a first loss is high in both arms and does
% not track bankruptcy: it is 69\% in the Gemini choosing arm against 92\% in its
% forced arm, because a large enough first wager ends the game before a second one is
% possible -- 320 of that arm's 769 ruined games end on their first wager.}
%
% Optional one-line replacement for the existing sentence at appendix.tex:1222, which
% currently says only "At a forced $70 stake most models decline to play at all":
% \rev{At the primary $\$10$ forced stake, by contrast, participation runs from 62.2\% to
% 99.4\% across the six models (Table~\ref{tab:companion-metrics}), so declining to play
% is a cap effect rather than a property of the forced arm.}
